# Country scope, players only, once a year: one doctrine event whose condition holds.
oe_form_yearly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1346
			oe_form_is_steppe_people = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_form_ev2_done value = 1 }
		oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_ev3_done }
			current_year >= 1520
			has_advance = oe_form_adv_combined_arms_manuals
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_form_ev3_done value = 1 }
		oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_ev4_done }
			has_advance = oe_form_adv_ordre_mixte_staff
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_form_ev4_done value = 1 }
		oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_ev6_done }
			has_ports = yes
			current_year >= 1571
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_form_ev6_done value = 1 }
		oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_ev7_done }
			has_advance = oe_form_adv_arsenale_shipbuilding
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_form_ev7_done value = 1 }
		oe_mark_player_global_flavor_cd = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.7
	}
}
